# Ketopia

> Your all-in-one keto companion: track macros, fasting, water, and weight, follow meal plans, and discover keto recipes.

Ketopia helps users start and sustain a ketogenic lifestyle with personalized tracking, recipes, community support, and curated meal plans.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Ketopia and getting started.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Subscription plans (Basic $19, VIP $99/year).
- [Recipes](/recipes): Keto recipe library.
- [Tracker](/tracker): Daily macro and food tracker.
- [Progress](/progress): Weight, body composition, and analytics dashboard.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Keto food marketplace.
- [Community](/community): Member community and messaging.
- [Challenges](/challenges): Keto challenges and leaderboards.
- [Guide](/guide): Keto starter guide.

- [Custom Plan](/custom-plan): VIP personalized meal plans.
- [30-Day Keto](/tracker/30-day-keto): 30-day keto streak tracker.
